meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入一个研究问题,拿到带引用、经过复核的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常遇到需要系统查证、逐条引用来源的复杂调研任务
copy.tagline_en: Turn a research question into a cited, reviewed report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face complex questions needing systematic, cited investigation

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会当研究主控兼团队负责人：先自己划范围、写 brief，再组建协作团队（每个研究轴一个成员，外加一名怀疑者），把发现实时写进会话目录，产出每条结论都带引用或代码验证的报告。开工会打印 ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED!。
howto.when: 当你明确要求 ulw-research（含 /ulw-research、$ulw-research 等写法）、任何 “ulw” 研究措辞，或明确要求深度研究/超精确调查时接管；普通提问不会触发，只会被提示该技能可用。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我研究一下 <主题>
say.note: 它会先问你交付格式，再组队开工

say.text: 做一次 ulw 深度研究：X 是否真的导致 Y？
say.note: 每条结论都要有引用或代码证明

say.text: 对 <主题> 开一次 ultradebate 研究
say.note: 有争议的结论会进辩论回合互相攻击

howto.what_en: Claude acts as research orchestrator and team lead: it scopes the question, writes a brief, builds a cooperating team (one member per axis), journals findings live, and delivers a synthesis where every claim has a citation or code proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for ulw-research (incl. /ulw-research), any "ulw" research wording, or a deep/ultra-precise investigation; an ordinary question does not.

say_en.note: It asks the output format first, then builds the team.

say_en.text: Do ulw deep research: does X actually cause Y?
say_en.note: Every claim needs a citation or a code proof.
Contested claims go through debate rounds.
